summary: Enhance your leadership capabilities and quality management expertise with our tailored training programs. Start your journey towards excellence now!
lede: Quality-focused leadership helps managers connect team behavior and process decisions with quality objectives. For professionals responsible for teams, processes, and customer outcomes, the course covers process mapping, root-cause analysis with 5 Whys and fishbone diagrams, and using PDCA cycles and quality KPIs to guide improvement and feedback.
audienceIntro: This Leadership and Quality Management Training is tailored for professionals who already carry responsibility for teams, processes, and customer outcomes and now need to connect their leadership approach directly to quality performance.
modules: Process Thinking, SIPOC, and Value Streams
Lean Principles, Standard Work, and Visual Management
Data-Driven Quality: KPIs, SPC, and Dashboards
Leading Continuous Improvement and Reporting Results
prerequisites: To get the most from this intermediate to advanced program, you should have 3–8 years of experience in a supervisory, team lead, quality, operations, or project management role. You should already manage people, processes, or service delivery in some capacity and be familiar with basic concepts such as KPIs, process steps, and performance reviews. No formal Six Sigma belt or ISO 9001 background is required, but prior exposure will help you move faster through the tools. No coding or programming is required. Advanced topics such as statistical process control and Lean Six Sigma are taught at the operational application level so you can commission, interpret, and lead improvement work, not at a technical engineering depth.
